Council Chambers of City Hall

AGENDA
OF A REGULAR MEETING
OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA 90274
Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.
NEXT RESOLUTION NO. R19-38
NEXT ORDINANCE NO. O19-743
CALL TO ORDER
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
ROLL CALL
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
MAYOR’S REPORT – MATTERS OF COMMUNITY INTEREST
CONSENT AGENDA (ITEMS 1 - 10) All items under this heading are considered to be routine and will be enacted by one motion, unless a Councilmember or staff requests that an item be removed for separate discussion. Any item removed from the Consent Agenda will be considered immediately following the motion to approve the Consent Agenda.
PUBLIC COMMENTS FOR ITEMS ON CONSENT AGENDA
Speakers shall be provided up to 3 minutes to speak regarding all topics on the Consent Agenda.

Draft City Council Action Minutes
Recommendation: Review and Approve.

b.

e.

f.

Minutes

Demands of December 10, 2019
Recommendation: Approve payment of Motions #1 and #2.
a.
Motion #1 – Payroll Warrant of November 29, 2019
b.
Motion #2 – Warrant Register of December 10, 2019
Demands
3.
Acceptance of Donations
Recommendation: Receive and File.
Staff Report
4.
Appointment of Acting City Manager
Recommendation: It is recommended the City Council appoint Mr. Kenneth Rukavina as Acting City Manager and adopt Resolution No. 19-35 re-allocating budgeted funds from the City Manager’s program to the Public Works program in the amount of $36,000 to provide for additional professional services to support the Acting City Manager until the permanent City Manager begins work with the City.
Staff Report
5.
Approval of Agreement with Ron’s Maintenance, Inc. for FY 19/20 and FY 20/21 Catch Basin Cleaning Services City-Wide
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve the Agreement with Ron’s Maintenance Inc. in a total amount of $274,322 to perform FY 19/20 and FY20/21 catch basin cleaning services and catch basin cleaning services and authorize the Mayor to sign the Agreement.
Staff Report
6.
Approval of Amendment No. 1 to Agreement No. C16-40 with Los Angeles County Flood Control District Relating to Trash Excluder Maintenance
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve Amendment No. 1 to the agreement with Los Angeles County Flood Control District for the maintenance of County-owned catch basins modified by the installation of trash excluders.
Staff Report
7.
Special Event Application for the Lunada Bay Homeowners Association's "Santa in the Park" Event Scheduled for Wednesday, December 11th, 2019
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve the request of the Lunada Bay Homeowners Association to hold its annual "Santa in the Park" on Wednesday, December 11, 2019 from 4:00 p.m. to 7:00 p.m. at Lunada Bay Park and the adjacent street of Via Anacapa contingent on receipt of the complete ABC License by 5:00 p.m. on December 6, 2019, as well as permit the posting of promotional signs prior to a the event.
Staff Report
8.
Planning Commission Actions of November 12, 2019
Recommendation: Receive and File.
Staff Report
9.
Monthly Investment Transaction Report - November 30, 2019
Recommendation: Receive and File.
Staff Report
10.
Re-Adoption on Second Reading of Ordinances: O19-740 Amending Chapter 18.28 (Outdoor Lighting) of the PVEMC; O19-739 Amending the PVEMC Regulations Relating to Short-Term Rental and Commercial Events; O19-739 Amending Chapter 28 Title 2 of the PVEMC relating to Emergency Preparedness and Coordination; O19-738 Amending Section 2.04.010 of the Municipal Code to Change the Starting time of City Council Regular Meetings; O19-737 Amending Section 8.28.040 of the PVEMC Regulating the Use of Leaf Blowers
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council re-adopt Ordinances O19-737, O19-738, O19-739, O19-740 and O19-742.
Staff Report
COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC
This portion of the agenda is reserved for comments from the public on items which are NOT on the agenda. Due to state law, no action can be taken by the Council this evening on matters presented under this section. If the Council determines action is warranted, the item may be referred to staff or placed on a future Council agenda.
ORDINANCE/PUBLIC HEARING(S) - NONE
OLD BUSINESS
11.
Review of Palos Verdes Drive West Corridor Feasibility Study
Recommendation: Receive and File.
Staff Report
12.
Update and Discussion of the Activities of the Pension Ad Hoc Committee and the Police Ad Hoc Committee
Recommendation: It is recommended the City Council receive updates from the Council Ad Hoc Committees, discuss the status of their work, and provide any direction Council deems appropriate.
Staff Report
NEW BUSINESS
13.
South Bay Regional Public Communications Authority Public Safety Dispatch Services Feasibility Study Phase Two
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council 1) Authorize Phase Two of the Feasibility Study for the consolidation of public safety dispatch services with South Bay Regional Public Communications Authority; and 2) Adopt Resolution R19-37 adjusting the FY19/20 Budget to appropriate $25,000 for the Phase Two Feasibility Study.
Staff Report
14.
Presentation of the Comprehensive Annual Financial Report (CAFR) for the Period Ending June 30, 2019
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council receive and file the Comprehensive Annual Financial Report for the period ending June 30, 2019.
Staff Report
15.
Consideration of Third Amendment to the Concession Agreement Between the City of Palos Verdes Estates and the Palos Verdes Tennis Foundation and the Proposed 2020 Budget
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve Amendment No. 3 to the Palos Verdes Tennis Foundation concession agreement and the proposed 2020 Budget.
Staff Report
16.
Request to Amend License Agreement with Lunada Bay Little League and Palos Verdes Little League for Use of George Allen Field to Delete the Requirement for Payment of Utilities and Waive Past and Future Utility Costs
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council waive past and current year utility costs and direct the Leagues to pursue approval of hanging banner signs on the outfield fence in order for the Leagues to have an opportunity to develop a sponsorship program to generate additional revenue for their operations.
Staff Report
17.
Discussion and Consideration of Filling Vacancies and Promotions
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council authorize the Interim City Manager to 1.) fill the one Finance Director, one Permit Technician, one Maintenance Worker, and one Police Services Aides, and 2.) promote two vacant Police Corporal positions, and the soon to be vacant Police Sergeant position.
Staff Report
18.
Establishment and Funding of a Contingency Fund in the City Managers Program to Allow the Interim City Manager to Issue Merit Increases for Performance Evaluations, Specialty Pay and Council Approved Labor Contract Obligations
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council 1.) adopt Resolution R19-36 establishing a contingency fund in the City Managers program and funding it in the amount of $88, 200 in order the interim city manager to appropriate funds back in the city managers contingency fund for performance evaluations and specialty pays and 2.) authorize the interim city manager to issue 5% retro acting pay to the assistant to the city manager for performing the duties of the City Clerk.
Staff Report
19.
Consideration of Establishing an Environmental Committee Consisting of Palos Verdes Estates Residents
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council consider this item and provide direction to staff.
Staff Report
STAFF REPORTS
i.
City Manager's Report
MAYOR & CITY COUNCILMEMBERS' REPORTS
ADJOURNMENT TO WEDNESDAY, JANUARY 15, 2019, AT 6:30 P.M. IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBERS OF CITY HALL FOR THE PURPOSE OF A REGULAR MEETING.
ii.
This City Council meeting can be viewed via live-stream or on demand thereafter on the City Website at www.pvestates.org

Dated this 6th day of December, 2019.
Lauren Pettit, City Clerk
